content: Status API conventions: envelope = data + meta (server_time, request_id) with one of data/error per response, never 200-with-error-body; lists never naked arrays; timestamps ISO8601 UTC with Z, null for known-unset. Degraded/partial: 200 if client can still use partial data (signal degraded/staleness flag in body), 503 only if data unusable; stale-but-served data = 200 with body staleness flag / as-of timestamp - do NOT overload HTTP cache headers for app staleness semantics; 207 for bulk partial success. Data provenance honest reporting: as-of date field standard on state resources (e.g. market_state.json has date, zt_pool_state has as_of_date+last_updated). 200 means processed, not happy path.
